hair.summary: In focus: strands after values, light strands indented or lifted. Out of focus (this brief): no strands at all, a dark mass with a soft blurred sheen band, edges melting into the grass, darks in carbon laid first.

rules.rule: In focus: general values first, then thin strokes following the strands, brush blending, darker layers, lifted highlights.
rules.source: Skillshare, Drawing Realistic Hair and Beard with Graphite (lesson notes): https://www.skillshare.com/en/classes/drawing-realistic-hair-and-beard-with-graphite/1384601388

rules.rule: In focus, light strands are indented before tone or lifted with an eraser pen.
rules.source: Skillshare, Drawing Realistic Hair and Beard with Graphite (lesson notes): https://www.skillshare.com/en/classes/drawing-realistic-hair-and-beard-with-graphite/1384601388; Veronica's Art, graphite portrait techniques: https://veronicasart.com/?p=5729; docs/styles/graphite-hyperrealism.md section 8

rules.rule: Out of focus: no strands and no indents; keep the mass, its shadow side and one or two soft sheen bands (out-of-focus structure 0.6-1.2 L*).
rules.source: Dessindigo, blur effect: https://dessindigo.com/en/blog/drawing-tutorial/draw-blur-effect; LoC FSA/OWI 2017762891 (measured): https://www.loc.gov/item/2017762891/

rules.rule: Edges soften gradually with distance from the focal plane; hair farther away melts wider.
rules.source: Wikipedia, Depth of field: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Depth_of_field; Wildlife Art Store, create depth: https://www.wildlifeartstore.com/create-depth-in-your-drawing/

rules.rule: An out-of-focus glint becomes a soft round disc, never a streak.
Dark hair is near black (photograph median L* 4, lights to 40-54): carbon first, blended lightly; graphite alone stops near L* 40.
rules.source: LoC FSA/OWI 2017762891 (measured): https://www.loc.gov/item/2017762891/; docs/calibration/graphite-hyperrealism.md What still limits 2

rules.rule: Blend inner tones clipped to the mass with a large brush, but blend across the edge unclipped so it blurs into the ground.

keep: layer 1 mass first, silhouette wider than the skull
hairline graded into skin, never outlined
avoid: strands or indented lines in out-of-focus hair
a grey mass where the photograph is near black
flags: Layer 1's 'a handful of strands at the light' is overruled out of focus by the optics: draw none.
sources: Skillshare, Drawing Realistic Hair and Beard with Graphite (lesson notes): https://www.skillshare.com/en/classes/drawing-realistic-hair-and-beard-with-graphite/1384601388
Veronica's Art, graphite portrait techniques: https://veronicasart.com/?p=5729
